steps.content: You fight through the ambush and storm into the ship, only to find the entire deck empty, save for a few puppets.
No sign of the suspect. No sign of the victim who sent the distress signal. Barely any documents left. Only the red emergency lights flash across hollow, gaudy halls.
Did they get tipped off? Had they prepared for this? Something feels wrong. You need to find someone, anyone, to answer your questions. And then you hear a voice...

steps.speaker: Panicked Guest
steps.content: Who the hell are you?! I said that no one was to enter without my permission!
The patrol team kicks down every VIP room door until they finally discover two living souls who can still speak.

One is clutching a lamp to shield himself, scared out of his wits. The other, scantily clad in expensive robes, quickly regains his composure after the initial shock and begins barking orders. Apparently, he'd been having such a good time that he didn't even notice he'd been left behind.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Hehe... This one's got serious issues.
The doctor snickers at the comedic scene. A DisCorps soldier, taking the cue, steps forward and restrains the man.

steps.speaker: Panicked Guest
steps.content: What do you think you're doing? Get off me! My father is—
The soldier, tired of his whining, pulls out his gun and fires a shot into the floor by the man's feet. The noble captive suddenly remembers his manners and meekly raises both hands.
Another soldier throws a towel around the man hugging the lamp, and brings the pair before you.
Both shake their heads frantically.
One continues shaking his head, but the other misses the beat and accidentally nods.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Who are you delivering intel to? Who's your handler?! What does Farland want from you?!

steps.speaker: Panicked Guest
steps.content: I don't know! They... I think they all left! Said they were ending the voyage early.

A few more rounds of interrogation don't come up with anything. The one who talks is screaming his head off, the other's jaw is chattering so hard he can't form words. Both have wet themselves. They don't seem to be lying.

The interrogation leaves you breathless. The contamination ravages your body, making it hard to do the job you've done so many times. Worse, you can see the soldiers running out of patience. A few more stupid remarks from these two pathetic fools, and their brains might end up on the carpet. You wave a hand, dismissing the two sorry specimens.
Just as you thought, the masterminds are cautious. The moment they smell trouble, they abandon their operations and escape.
...Or is it the case?

Intel confirmed suspicious passenger ships sneaking into the sandstorm zone just yesterday, likely bringing new guests to the cruise. Which means that up until yesterday, Euphoria was still in business.
Was this place cleared out overnight? All those people, all the documents, all the evidence that might have been left... How long would that take? How many hands? And where did they all go?

The soldiers are still combing through the ship. It will take time, but your intuition is telling you: they won't find anything. You're starting to see the true purpose of this conspicuous, trap-filled vessel that appeared so suddenly...
[Screen shakes, storm intensifies]

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Cough, cough!
The storm intensifies unnaturally, triggering a violent coughing fit. You spit out a mouthful of contaminated blood.

This isn't just the effect of the Tide of Ashes... You sense a power gathering nearby, awakening, jumbling your mind into chaos. But you vaguely latch onto that feeling. Or rather, you're determined to catch it...

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Only four Sages wielding this power would suffice to bring you considerable... inconvenience.
Of course... it's them... Subtly different, yet strikingly similar. You've unexpectedly gotten close to one of your targets. Between coughs, you can't help but smile.
That's right. Why bother taking away the evidence? Destroying it on site works just as well. You need to hurry up.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Leave a squad here. Search the area and keep watch. Stay safe. Everyone else, follow me. We're turning back for a thorough search. The real culprits are hidden deeper. Camouflage, sandstorms, wherever they are hiding... we're digging them out. Judging by the two clowns they left behind, they can't be far from here.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Those bastards are hiding nearby... Find them... Catch them alive!
Your words stir something, and the atmosphere on the ship changes. Silently, the soldiers move to support you, ready to head out at once.
As you pass the two captives, they timidly speak up.

steps.speaker: Confused Guest
steps.content: Er... I think there was someone else. He was here just now... said he had something to do, needed to come back to find someone...

steps.speaker: Panicked Guest
steps.content: I bet he was trying to sneak off with a dancer he fancied. After all, Mr. E never lets anyone take the girls off the ship.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Mr. E</color>...?
[Begin Battle]
